intro: Rough Hollow is one of the biggest neighborhoods in Lakeway, and CleanzATX works in nearly every section of it. Tyler grew up a few miles from here and cleans glass on both the lake side and the hilltops.

sections.h2: How Rough Hollow is laid out
paragraphs: Rough Hollow is a master planned community with 21 to 22 sections and several thousand lots at build out, though the exact count is not published. It runs along about three miles of Lake Travis shoreline, and the main road through it is Highlands Blvd. Most of the amenities sit at two points: Highland Village, the hub with the lazy river, and the Rough Hollow Yacht Club and marina, which has 294 or more slips. Homes are mostly stucco and stone, in a Mediterranean or Hill Country modern style, and the community is still being built.

The sections fall into rough groups. The lakefront group is The Peninsula, The Point, Waters Edge and Lakeside. The hilltop group is The Bluffs, Vista Ridge, West Rim, East Rim, The Overlook and The Summit. Canyon Pass, Highland Terrace, Cypress Ridge and the rest sit in between, and the townhome and villa pockets are their own thing.

sections.h2: Lakefront and hilltop glass are different jobs
paragraphs: On the shoreline the problem is spray and sun. Lake water is hard, sprinklers add more, and west facing glass over the water shows every streak after about three in the afternoon. Left alone, those white spots can etch into the glass. Pure water at near 0 TDS dries without leaving anything behind, and a hard water treatment handles older spotting.

Up on the ridges the glass is bigger and taller. Hilltop homes tend to have large view windows, second floor sliders and three story walls of glass facing the lake. Our water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so no ladders touch the house. Wind carries limestone dust and construction dust up there too, since new lots are still opening.

We run Rough Hollow as a route, not a one off. Gated sections like The Peninsula and The Enclave are scheduled around the homeowner's gate arrangement, and the master HOA plus sub associations apply, so we keep trucks tidy and quiet. We often book two or three neighbors on the same morning. Window cleaning pairs well with a house soft wash for stucco, a gentle soft wash for limestone (never pressure washed) and a patio hand clean.

Sizes here range from about 1,778 to 9,000 sq ft. A 4,000 sq ft home is about $400 for exterior windows, and a 1,800 sq ft home hits the $200 minimum. Allow 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft outside and about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft inside. Text us for a quote, usually back within the hour.

faq.q: Which Rough Hollow sections do you clean?
faq.a: Nearly all of them, including The Peninsula, The Point, The Bluffs, Vista Ridge, Canyon Pass and the villa and townhome pockets. If you are unsure which section you live in, send a text with your street and we will place it.

faq.q: Do you get through the gates?
faq.a: Yes. The Peninsula and The Enclave are gated, so we set up access with you before the visit. You tell us how you want us let in and we plan the stop around it.

faq.q: Can you reach the tall lake view windows?
faq.a: Exterior glass up to three stories is reached from the ground with water fed poles, so there are no ladders against the house. Interior glass on two story rooms is done by hand with cotton covered ladders and drop cloths.

faq.q: How often should Rough Hollow homes be cleaned?
faq.a: Lakefront homes do well on a quarterly plan because of spray and sun. Hilltop and inland homes are fine twice or three times a year. The Clean Windows Club saves 10% to 20% depending on the plan.
